verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly establishes green accents for the selected machine design.
The client explicitly selects beige as the primary design color.
The platform exchange and source text establish matching beige and font colors for the added platform.
The immediately preceding question makes clear that beige specifies the cursive K color when the buttons are green.
The source discusses general visual appeal and use at events or a shop, but does not change the scope of the beige-and-green color scheme.
The client explicitly directs that the rendering colors be recreated on the machine and separate base.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
The initial renderings that I sent you are all AI generated. The proportions of an AI picture aren’t going to match with what can actually be made. With that said, if a new base is to built, I like the buttons and knobs on the renderings. I would like for them to be silver like a DJ booth. I would like lights and the measuring units around the bowls. 

Also, I like the power button in the renderings. You mentioned putting a K on the buttons earlier. I would like to explore that. 

Karla Burton
